subject.title: feat(matrix): add configurable read receipt timing

question: Should OpenClaw expose the full Matrix `immediate`/`on-reply`/`off` receipt policy with per-account overrides, or should the feature be narrowed before merge?
rationale: The feature introduces a new compatibility-sensitive public configuration contract; the linked canonical issue is explicitly awaiting maintainer product direction, and a mechanical migration cannot choose the permanent surface area.

options.title: Approve the full policy surface
options.body: Keep all three modes and account overrides, but require an explicit doctor migration and upgrade coverage for formerly accepted account values.

options.title: Narrow to a global opt-in
options.body: Ship only the channel-level opt-in behavior if per-account policy is not wanted as a permanent public contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the full policy surface
recommendation.body: Keep all three modes and account overrides, but require an explicit doctor migration and upgrade coverage for formerly accepted account values.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the active proposer with the complete behavior rationale and can incorporate the deciding maintainer’s chosen scope.
